idea-plugin.name: Minecraft Sound Browser
idea-plugin.description:
Browse, search and play every vanilla Minecraft sound without leaving the IDE — and hear the sounds you reference in code with a single click right in the editor.

Sound browser

  • All sound events of any Minecraft release (1.7.2+) or snapshot, organized into categories and groups: Blocks › anvil › place, Entities › zombie › hurt, Music Discs, Interface…
  • Instant search that understands every naming style: zombie hurt, entity.zombie.hurt, ENTITY_ZOMBIE_HURT, minecraft:entity.zombie.hurt
  • Favorites for the sounds you use most

Player

  • Interactive waveform — click or drag to seek
  • Play / pause, stop, replay and loop
  • Browse every variant of a sound event or pick a weighted random one, just like the game does
  • Live volume and pitch (0.5×–2.0×), matching the pitch argument of playSound
  • Per-file volume and pitch from sounds.json applied for an accurate preview

Editor integration

  • A ▶ button right after every sound reference — several sounds on one line each get their own button:
    • Sound.ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP — Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, including pre-1.9 names like Sound.LEVEL_UP
    • SoundEvents.ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP (Yarn) and SoundEvents.PLAYER_LEVELUP (Mojang mappings: NeoForge, Forge)
    • SoundEvent.X (Minestom) and SoundTypes.X (Sponge)
    • the same constants statically imported, without the class name
    • "minecraft:entity.player.levelup" string keys — Adventure, commands, data packs
  • Your mod's or resource pack's own sounds from assets/<namespace>/sounds.json: ModSounds.BOSS_ROAR, "mymod:boss.roar" and the entries of sounds.json itself, played straight from the project's .ogg files
  • Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Scala, JSON and plain text files (e.g. .mcfunction associated with Text)
  • Clicking it plays the sound in a compact mini player with a seekable waveform, pause, stop and switching between the sound's variants
  • The button color follows the IDE accent or can be picked in the settings
  • Copy any sound as a key, namespaced key, Bukkit constant, player.playSound(...) call, Adventure Sound.sound(...) or /playsound command

Lightweight & offline-friendly

  • Sound data is downloaded on demand from Mojang's official servers using the IDE proxy settings, verified by SHA-1 and cached — everything you've played once works offline
  • Works in every IntelliJ-based IDE; support for each language activates automatically

Open it from View › Tool Windows › Minecraft Sounds.

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. No game assets are bundled with this plugin.
